source.label: general-ui-ux-practice-profile
source.basis: Cross-library UI/UX heuristics plus UI-lab registry, Storybook, Playwright, and Forge evidence.
evidenceFiles: ui-lab Playwright catalog and keyboard tests

practices.name: Accessibility first interactions
practices.uiLabRule: Every interactive surface needs keyboard, focus, label, and screen-reader behavior represented in evidence.
practices.forgeTemplateUse: Template generators should carry accessibility states and keyboard evidence into generated task packets.

practices.name: Bounded variant matrix
practices.uiLabRule: Expose reusable density, surface, state, and mode axes as bounded metadata, not one-off visual cases.
practices.forgeTemplateUse: Template generators should derive controls from declared variant axes instead of inspecting source internals.

practices.name: Semantic theme tokens
practices.uiLabRule: Use semantic theme tokens for color, borders, focus rings, and surfaces; avoid hardcoded palette decisions.
practices.forgeTemplateUse: Template generators should emit theme-token-safe examples that can move across brands.

practices.name: Responsive layout integrity
practices.uiLabRule: Components and templates must keep stable dimensions, readable text, and no incoherent overlap across mobile and desktop.
practices.forgeTemplateUse: Template generators should preserve responsive constraints and viewport evidence for every block.

practices.name: Clear information hierarchy
practices.uiLabRule: Use predictable heading, description, action, and supporting metadata structure for scanability.
practices.forgeTemplateUse: Template generators should keep hierarchy slots explicit when composing templates.

practices.name: Storybook variant evidence
practices.uiLabRule: Expose default, state, mode, and variant matrix stories with stable Storybook ids.
practices.forgeTemplateUse: Template generators should use Storybook ids as visual evidence anchors for each template input.

practices.name: Browser and a11y proof
practices.uiLabRule: Record browser behavior, a11y, visible rendering, console cleanliness, and interaction evidence before marking Forge-ready.
practices.forgeTemplateUse: Template generators should require test evidence refs for interactive or overlay components.

practices.name: State complete surfaces
practices.uiLabRule: Represent default, focus, disabled, invalid, loading, and empty states where the component can reach them.
practices.forgeTemplateUse: Template generators should include state coverage before marking a template reusable.

practices.name: Motion with restraint
practices.uiLabRule: Use motion only to clarify state changes, and keep reduced-motion mode in the evidence model.
practices.forgeTemplateUse: Template generators should avoid decorative motion and preserve reduced-motion variants.

practices.name: Composition ready slots
practices.uiLabRule: Keep component parts, slots, registry dependencies, and template-safe examples explicit.
practices.forgeTemplateUse: Template generators should compose from declared slots, dependencies, and examples.
